structured_output.analysis: The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits per weight. The base iso_3.15 averages 3.14795 bits [E514ab09c524e], so almost nothing is left. Any cell upgrade has to be paid for with a downgrade, but the evidence only gives downgrade costs for the layers where loss is concentrated, and those are expensive. For example, the up_proj layers lose about 0.02 KL going from int3 to int2 (E9dcea9299d95, Ea5d557685c3e). The cheapest upgrade found is 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 (0.00633) to rht_gptq_int3 (0.00181) [E4c3f9b73e065, E90bd4b2f3645]. No measured downgrade of about 3.1M weights costs less than that gain. None of the retrieved layers has a same-bit swap that beats its current assignment; for example, 27.up_proj already uses the better int3 variant [Ef04d8aa7bded vs E8972491007e7]. The whole-recipe KL measured 0.436 against a prediction of 0.398, which suggests interactions where the layer errors add up. So this round tries option changes that cost no bits: GPTQ act_order, and act_order combined with a different damp, applied to every GPTQ-family method.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: Uses the same cells as iso_3.15 (KL 0.436 [E514ab09c524e]) with act_order=true on all GPTQ-family methods, so the stored bits do not change. The loss sits mostly in int3/int2 GPTQ MLP layers, such as 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] and 27.up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded], and act_order targets exactly that low-bit GPTQ error.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp05
proposals.rationale: Uses the same cells as iso_3.15 [E514ab09c524e] with act_order=true and damp=0.05, so the stored bits do not change. Whole-recipe KL was measured at 0.436 against a predicted 0.398, so a stronger damp may make the Hessian less overfit to the calibration set. This matters most on layers with extreme activations, such as 27.up_proj with activation kurtosis 1090 [E24beed188b6a].

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp003
proposals.rationale: Uses the same cells as iso_3.15 (KL 0.436 [E514ab09c524e]) with damp=0.003 in place of the default, so the stored bits do not change. This brackets the damp axis against the damp=0.05 grid, to see whether weaker regularisation lowers the GPTQ error in the dominant rht_gptq_int3 MLP layers, such as 3.up_proj at 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5].
